response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM c), d AS (SELECT observstation, cnt AS telescope_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS diff FROM s) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, diff FROM d WHERE diff >= (SELECT diff FROM d ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM d) <= 10 ORDER BY diff DESC
